notes.title: Small Patch available!
notes.notes:
-Hello runners!, this update fixes a small bug that occurs when starting a new game, which caused some levels to not unlock correctly.

-In addition, it is no longer necessary to be inside the button to go to the next level, you only need to touch the button once and when the word continue appears, you can go to the next level whenever you want by pressing the E on your keyboard.

-New music for the farm level is available.

We hope you enjoy this update.
RED PIXEL TEAM <3

notes.title: New Loading Screens!
notes.notes:
Hello Runners! a new update for Speed Run is available.
This update fix a bug that some players experienced when playing the game at 100fps or higher that caused keyboard inputs to not register correctly.
Is now fixed and loading screens are now faster and have more personality.

We hope you enjoy this update. Keep running!

-Red Pixel Team <3[previewyoutube=WKcr8d8KWow;full][previewyoutube=WKcr8d8KWow;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Sweet Paradise Update!
notes.notes:
Sweet Update new content:
-Sweet Paradise level!, A new level filled with delicious desserts like ice creams, cakes, donuts, candies, and other delicious treats that we shouldn't eat, but do anyway!

Experience one of the most challenging levels in Speed ​​Run history.

-New Characters: The Sweet King and his butler Felicio.

-Vaporwave platform fixed, fixed a bug that made the starting the platform clip through the geometry, making the jump for the player unfair.

-Fixed a collision error in the debris in the Vaporwave level.

-Some minor difficulty balance made in some levels. 

-More extras added to the main menu and new concept art of the behind the scenes is available to see.

notes.title: Resolution & Graphics Settings Fixed!
notes.notes:
-Fixed the Resolution & Graphics Settings.
-Added new options for the audio of the game.
-Fixed some graphical bugs.
-Improved the overall performance of the game.

notes.title: Speed Run Steam Edition Release Date (JUNE 24)
notes.notes:
Hello Runners! 
We are excited to announce that the Steam edition of Speed ​​Run will be released this June 24th.
We put some new content in this version before releasing our largest update to date.
These are some of the new features:
-New Medals system  you can earn based on your race time.
-New extras menu where you can learn more about the Speed Run characters and their concept art.
-New Steam achievements to unlock!
-The snow level has been completely revamped with a more cozy look!

We sincerely hope you enjoy this new release.
See you on June 24!


-RED PIXEL Team.
